title.narrative: Cross-border Youth Dialogue - CYD

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the action is to contribute towards improved participatory democracies and reconciliation through empowering civil society¿s role and enabling a structured cooperation and dialogue between the people of Kosovo and Serbia in order to strengthen their path towards EU integration.

The Specific Objectives (SOs) of this action are:

SO1. Improve relations and communication between the people of Kosovo and Serbia through establishing a structured people-to-people intercultural dialogue in order to empower them in enabling a real normalisation process;

SO2. Engage youth as champions of positive changes towards normalisation of cross-border relations at community level.
